# Common API behavior

## Owned values

Generated owned values are immutable document inputs or captured results.

Constructors normalize declared collections into owned immutable containers,
usually tuples or read-only mappings. Mutating an input list afterwards does
not change the value. Immutable nested values may be shared; ownership does
not promise a deep copy of every object. Construction performs no host IO;
document admission and validation happen through explicit authoring calls.

Reading fields, repr and summary performs no host IO and creates no host
resource. Results retain their captured data; field access does not refresh
them from the document. Use an explicit query for current host state.
For CompactValue records, repr and summary are bounded previews, capped at
1,024 characters. Tuple projections retain normal Python tuple display.
Explicit field access exposes the owned data; ApiDescription.format() exposes
the complete help text.

These conventions apply to owned data values. Runtime, Session, Edit, Jobs
and resource leases have their own lifecycle and explicit IO methods; follow
their entry documentation for waiting, recovery and close requirements.

## __repr__

Return a local summary capped at 1,024 characters, with no RPC/full scan.

Large arrays and bytes show bounded samples/counts. Explicit field access
still exposes the owned full value; no host resource is created/released.

## summary

Return a bounded, local summary; full fields remain explicitly accessible.

## collection-page

name=None disables filtering; a string matches exactly and case-sensitively, preserving duplicate names. limit is 1..256, defaults to 128 and must fit the host collection-record limit; count/byte/scan budgets can yield shorter or empty pages. cursor=None starts a scan; otherwise pass Page.next_cursor with the same collection and filter. None as next_cursor ends the scan. A changed formal/candidate Source or Undo/Redo raises STALE_SOURCE: restart the scan without merging versions. After OutcomeUnknown recover the original Call to retain the captured page, even after peer publication. Query failures do not abort an Edit; Page owns its metadata and needs no close.

## collection-read

expected=None reads current content; an explicit Source is checked atomically and STALE_SOURCE rejects a changed source. Selected reads reject missing IDs or response budgets as a whole. Query failures do not abort an Edit. After OutcomeUnknown recover the original Call to obtain its captured result instead of submitting a fresh read. Snapshot and Batch own their values, perform no IO when inspected and have no host lease to close.

## edit-write

Writes change candidate state only, without file IO; commit publishes separately and returns Job[Receipt]. Normal Edit context exit commits and waits; an exceptional exit cancels ordinary candidates. Explicit commit Jobs must be waited for or closed. Ordinary write failures abort the candidate even when caught: repair inputs and start a new Edit. Confirmed Busy or pre-execution admission refusal preserves the candidate; follow recovery_action. OutcomeUnknown retains the original Call and exact return type: recover it instead of replaying the write, before cleanup.

## fixed-discriminator

A variant constructor supplies its fixed operation discriminator automatically. The attribute is read-only and is not a constructor argument or an editable business field. Choose a variant by its documented business effect; the discriminator identifies its wire operation.
